title: Rustine configuration
description: Non-sensitive settings of a project, read by Rustine from .rustine.yaml. Precedence: option, then this file, then environment variable, then default.

assignee.description: Usernames assigned to a merge request when it is created (--assignee).

reviewer.description: Usernames set as reviewers of a merge request when it is created (--reviewer).

notify.description: Usernames or groups mentioned (@name) in the description of a merge request, without assigning it (--notify).

labels.description: Labels of every merge request (--label). Default: security.

severity_label_format.description: Format of the severity label (--severity-label-format). Default: severity::{severity}.

locale.description: Language of the texts written in the project: merge requests and commits (--locale). Default: en.

branch.description: Branch to analyze: the fixes start from it and the merge requests target it (--branch). Default: the default branch of the project ($CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH).

group.description: Severity groups to process (--group). Default: every group in one merge request per ecosystem.

max_open_merge_requests.description: Stops opening new merge requests above this number (--max-open-merge-requests).

closed_grace_days.description: Does not open again a merge request closed by hand for the same fixes less than this many days ago (--closed-grace-days). Default: 30, 0 = always open.

include_dev.description: Also scan the development dependencies: require-dev, devDependencies (--include-dev). Default: false.

verify.description: When Trivy confirms the fixes (--verify): final (default, once when every package is handled), each (after every attempt the lockfile accepts) or none (the lockfile alone decides).

git_author_name.description: Author name of the commits (--git-author-name). Default: the token owner.

git_author_email.description: Author email of the commits (--git-author-email). Default: the token owner.
